lines.en: The grass is tall; I push through it.
My club rides my shoulder as I stroll.
The savanna's hot; I'll walk faster.
I cut through a gap in the rocks.
Small feet, small steps.
I see an anthill and kick it.

lines.zh: 背上的皮袋子晃来晃去。
lines.en: The hide sack bounces on my back.
I walk by the rocks to stay out of the sun.

lines.zh: 我边走边瞄着身后的影。
lines.en: I walk on, eyeing the shadow behind me.
This patch is mine; I walk where I like.
A grass stem hangs from my mouth.
The wind swallows my footsteps.
I sit on a rock and scratch my ear.
I grind my teeth and wait for dusk.
This grass tastes bitter.
My club needs replacing.

lines.zh: 数一数今天捡了几颗铁粒。
lines.en: Let me count today's iron nuggets.
My stomach growls — annoying.
I draw a circle in the sand.
Who put out the campfire?
I squat and watch a bug crawl.
My ear twitches — nothing.
My nose is full of dust.
I burp, and it reeks.
My cap is crooked; I can't be bothered.
I count my kin on my fingers.
No fighting today; just sitting.
The sun shifts an inch; I glance up.
I lean on a rock and doze.
Birds in the distance — not worth chasing.
What are you looking at, shorty?
You're taller. So what?
Nice boots — I'll take them.
Don't laugh; my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 你站那块石头上做什么。
lines.en: What are you doing on that rock?
We size each other up.
I bare my pointed teeth at you.
Stranger, back off.
No club in your hand — easier for me.
My hand creeps behind my back.
I glare to scare you a bit.
Come to take my turf?
Ow! You actually hit me.
My ears are ringing.
Is that all the strength you have?
I step back two paces to recover.
Blood runs from my nose.
That hit's worth a few nuggets.
That hurts — I'll remember you.
I bite down and don't cry out.
My cap flew off.
Once I recover, I'll hit back.
Hand me that iron nugget, quick.
Iron in your bag?

lines.zh: 我闻到你包里有油腥味。
lines.en: I smell grease and meat in your pack.
I'll trade you my club for it.
Half would be generous.
If you won't give it, I'll steal it.
I stand on tiptoe to reach your hand.
That thing would fetch plenty of nuggets.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，喉咙里咽了一下。
lines.en: I stare at your hands and swallow hard.
Don't eat it yet; save it for me.
Ow — who bumped into me?

lines.zh: 我的脚趾被你碾了一下。
lines.en: You ground one of my toes underfoot.
I can't out-shove you; move aside.
Dust flies where we collide.
You're sturdier. Noted.
Don't push; there's rock behind me.
I dropped my club.
One bump — I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 你别过我，我的火药桶差点炸。
lines.en: Don't shove past me; my powder keg nearly went off.
Steady — try again.
You live on this savanna too?
We'll guard this ground together.
My burrow fits two.
Follow me and keep quiet.
I'll split my meat with you.
Two clubs beat one.
From now on we rob together.
You scratch my back; I'll scratch yours.
We'll have a litter of little ones.
Only kin stand this close.
An iron nugget — into my pocket.
This meat is still warm to touch.
I pick up your wooden club.
A pebble — still useful.
I tuck it into my belt.
I pounce and pin it down first.
I slip it up my sleeve.
Edible? I'll keep it anyway.
I hug it and trot two paces.
It's dusty, but worth it.

lines.zh: 这片草我插过树枝做记号。
lines.en: I stuck twigs in this grass to mark it mine.
Grab him — don't let him run.

lines.zh: 我们来比一比谁跑得快。
lines.en: Let's see who's faster.
My club is up.
This one's big; go for the legs.
While he isn't looking, I creep up.
Locked on; no swapping.
You can't escape; I know this grass.
I want his things.
I'll shout for my kin.
I chase and curse together.
You're fast — annoying.
I'll cut around ahead.
The grass is deep and stings my eyes.
He's panting; so am I.
Club raised, ready to swing.
Don't climb; I'll throw rocks.
These short legs are doing their best.
There's a ditch ahead; he'll slow.
Catch him and there's meat.
My club lands on your knee.
One bite — just one.
I jab your ribs with my club.
That one landed solid.
You back off; I come again.
Ankles are cheapest to hit.
My nails rake you as well.
I shriek and lunge.
You guard your face; I hit your belly.
Hit, then run — don't linger.

lines.zh: 草叶还在我耳朵上挂着。
lines.en: Grass is still caught on my ear.
A club is already in my hand.
Nice spot — mine now.
I rub my eyes against the sun.
A newcomer — ugly one, too.

lines.zh: 我从土坑里爬出来挠头。
lines.en: I climb out of a dirt pit, scratching my head.
Hot sand under my feet.
Who's there? I smell sweat.
I climb out of a burrow.

lines.zh: 我钻出来，先看谁口袋松。
lines.en: I pop out and first check whose pockets hang loose.
I swing my club as a greeting.

lines.zh: 今天这片草原多了一个我。
lines.en: One more goblin on the savanna today.
My sleeve's on fire!
I landed on my tailbone.
Water up my nose.
I hadn't even thrown my bomb.
Who loosed that arrow?!
That light burns and scares me.
Hunger makes my legs weak.
Lightning hit my cap.

lines.zh: 下面空空的，我掉下去了。
lines.en: Nothing below and I'm dropping.
